OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the MIME type of the exported files.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_PRIMARY_COLOR.description: The primary color for the output PDF (hex format, e.g. '#ff8c00').

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_SECONDARY_COLOR.description: The secondary color for the output PDF (hex format, e.g. '#000000').

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_ADDRESS_LINE_1.description: The first line of your company address (e.g. company name).

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_ADDRESS_LINE_2.description: The second line of your company address (e.g. street address).

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_ADDRESS_LINE_3.description: The third line of your company address (e.g. city, state, country).

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_PHONE_NUMBER.description: The phone number of your company, displayed in the PDF footer.

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_EMAIL.description: The email of your company, displayed in the PDF footer.

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_COMPANY_WEBSITE.description: The website of your company, displayed in the PDF footer.

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_INDICATORS_ONLY.description: Whether or not to only include Observables that are Indicators in the report.

EXPORT_REPORT_PDF_DEFANG_URLS.description: Whether or not to replace 'http' in Url observables with 'hxxp'.
